title: Explain a result
text: Does a better test score always mean a better model?

options.text: No. I would also examine the data, uncertainty and the needs of the task.
options.response: 回答说明了关键条件和处理方法。

options.text: Yes. One higher score proves that the model is always better.
options.response: 这一说法忽略了关键条件，需要重新分析。

options.text: I would repeat the test but use the same data only.
options.response: 提到了部分处理方式，但解释还不完整。
